model_output.verdict: Your Title I teaching and K-8 certification are clear, and the reading growth and grade-level leadership back them up. I’d move your resume forward. I’d want to hear which teaching practices drove that growth.
write_up: Your resume is strong: it shows classroom teaching, reading growth and leadership of a grade-level team at Lincoln Heights. Your resume does its job; the fit of a particular opening and the competition for it will matter too.

The reading growth line is the standout because it gives a district assessment measure before and after your work. Your Washington K-8 certificate and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find alongside your teaching experience.

Let’s add the teaching practices behind that reading growth, then give the behavior support committee work a little more substance. You can also make the math curriculum pilot work harder by adding what changed after the pilot or training, if you know.
